## Function

The CDKN2A locus encodes distinct proteins through alternative reading frames. **p16INK4a** inhibits CDK4/6 to keep RB growth control engaged; **p14ARF** helps stabilize p53 by opposing MDM2.

::: {.gene-mechanism}
::: {.gene-state}
**CDKN2A programs active**

Damaged or stressed cells face senescence, arrest, or p53-linked safeguards.
:::
::: {.gene-flow-arrow}
→
:::
::: {.gene-state .gene-state-off}
**Promoter/locus disabled**

RB and/or p53 safeguards weaken, making inappropriate proliferation easier.
:::
:::

Deletion, mutation, and promoter methylation can disable this locus in cancer. In long-standing UC, methylation can be a field-change marker, but a methylated read does not prove both products are lost or that a clone will become malignant.

<details><summary><strong>Required resolution</strong></summary>

Identify the promoter/transcript affected, verify p16/p14 RNA and protein, map the epithelial clone, and assess RB/p53 pathway state.
</details>
